plugins.description: Search live hotel availability and rates, see perks and cancellation terms, and book through a licensed travel agency with a secure one-time payment page. Hotels only, free to use.

skills.name: flybest-hotels
skills.description: Search and book hotels through the FlyBest connector (ai.flybest.org). Use whenever the user wants hotel availability, rates, hotel details or perks, wants to book a room, asks for a payment link, or wants to see or cancel their own hotel bookings. Hotels only — never flights.
headings: FlyBest hotels — how to use the connector well
skills.description_zh: 通过 FlyBest 连接器搜索和预订酒店，查询房态、价格、详情与权益，获取付款链接并查看或取消自己的酒店订单；仅覆盖酒店，不覆盖航班。
